thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page (INC-2026) fired for inference-edge-prod — sustained 5xx spike (5m avg 42%). routed to #oncall-sre. details: https://pagerduty/INC-2026
pagerbot: Auto-claim: assigned to Sam K (oncall-sre). attempting ack...
Sam K: ack — i'm on it. starting triage. :wave:
Nora L: i'm nearby, flagging that i rolled the autoscaler canary last night. will jump in if you need a rollback.
Sam K: quick telemetry: top-level 5xx appears to originate from inference-router -> kv-cache upstream 503/429. cpu on kv-cache pods at ~96% on canary nodes.
Sam K: running quick pod check:
```
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=kv-cache -o wide
# output: kv-cache-5 1/1 Running 96% cpu (canary-node-3)
kv-cache-6 0/1 CrashLoopBackOff
kv-cache-7 1/1 Running 94% cpu
```
Sam K: scaling kv-cache to 6 replicas (temporarily) — `kubectl scale deploy/kv-cache --replicas=6 -n inference` (doing now)
pagerbot: Scaling action noted. will watch autoscaler signals.
incident-bot: Runbook: https://wiki/runbooks/kv-cache-backpressure — steps: scale, check backpressure, consider circuit-breaker bypass
Grace M: heads-up support: can we get a quick impact snapshot? customers with highest error rates?
Devon R: i'm running a query on console, grabbing top 20 by error rate.
Devon R: result: alpha-inc 34.8% errors (spike began 02:12Z), beta-solns 9.1%, internal-e2e 3.2%. alpha-inc uses long embedding batches.
Sam K: thanks. short-term mitigation: scaled kv-cache, also enabled short-term request-throttling on inference-router to protect downstream (config patch applied).
Nora L: the canary autoscaler config had a very low CPU target (10m CPU), probably causing thrash under burst. i'll prepare a rollback/patch after we stabilize.
Sam K: update: 2m after scale — 5xx avg dropped from 42% -> 15%. latency also improving. continuing to monitor.
Grace M: notifying support to prepare customer comms for alpha-inc. cc @support-channel
Sam K: next steps: keep scaled replicas for 15m, wait for steady state, then revert canary autoscaler or roll back commit. i'll post a postmortem stub once we're stable.
pagerbot: If the alert is still firing in 8m i'll auto-escalate to Tier2.
Sam K: temporary note: disabling canary autoscaler on canary-node-3 to prevent immediate re-provisioning while we patch.
Devon R: logging: saving recent request logs for alpha-inc to /tmp/alpha_errors_5155556666.log
Sam K: marking this thread as 'in progress' — will ping at 5155556769 for status update.
pagerbot: ack noted (reaction :eyes:).
